testimonials.name: Mei Lin Chong
text: Aisyah helped me land the role I'd been circling for years. My whole career had been in big tech, and I could tell that quant firms interview, communicate, and run their teams differently. She was hands-on prepping me for every round, so I walked in feeling prepared and confident instead of guessing.
They were so on top of things that I found out I was getting an offer the same night as my onsite.

Most importantly, they are honest people. A health issue came up after my onsite had already been booked; Aisyah spoke to the firm straight away and had it rescheduled. It was the right call — I still got the offer without putting my health second.
Thank you for a genuinely life-changing opportunity!

testimonials.name: Amir Hakimi
text: Aisyah is in a league of her own as a recruiter. She's been in the industry long enough to know exactly which firms would be the right fit for me, guided me through every interview round, and helped me negotiate the offer at Halvard. If you're exploring roles in quant finance or tech, she's the person to talk to.

testimonials.name: Arjun Menon
text: 10/10 experience with Daniel. I've never had a recruiter work with me the way he did — he narrowed the search to the firms that actually made sense for where I wanted my career to go, prepped me for each stage, and made sure the compensation package was what I needed. I'd tell anyone to work with him.

testimonials.name: Farid Zulkifli
text: I had a great experience working with Daniel. He introduced me to a range of firms, including a few I'd never have found on my own. I've just started at a startup he put me in front of, and it's exactly what I was looking for. He stayed on top of the process from start to finish — introductions, prep, offer negotiation, even chasing the contract. Highly recommended.

testimonials.name: Jason Teoh
text: Working with Priya was a genuine pleasure. She takes the time to understand what you actually want, and her persistence is unmatched — she kept digging until she uncovered an opportunity that fit me perfectly. Thoughtful, relentless, and exceptional at her craft.

testimonials.name: Vikram Nair
text: Priya's great. She narrowed my search to trading firms I'd actually be interested in and wouldn't have known about otherwise, had a ton of useful connections, and gave specific insight at every step. Responsive too — but she never called at 7am the way a lot of recruiters in this space do. Highly recommend working with her.

testimonials.name: Wei Jun Lau
text: Adam's mission is putting the most capable people in the highest-leverage seats, and he happens to be the most capable person I've met in recruiting. What made him great to work with wasn't just his access to the strongest firms or the connections that made every process smooth. It was his humility and steady support through every step — a rare thing when it comes to recruiters.

testimonials.name: Kelvin Ooi
text: Adam was foundational in helping me land my next role in engineering. Once we connected he took my experience, expertise and what I actually wanted into account and routed me to a few options that all turned into screenings. Along the way I really appreciated the check-ins, encouragement and collaboration that led to a fulfilling role I would never have found with my own scattershot approach. Having that support in today's job market was instrumental.

testimonials.name: Hafiz Rosli
text: Adam is incredibly helpful, going to great lengths to make sure you're properly equipped for the interview process. With his help and support, I'm now working as an Applied AI Engineer at Corvid AI!

bio: Nur Aisyah Rahman is the founder and Chief Executive Officer of FF Dev Studio. She started the studio after a decade placing quantitative researchers and platform engineers, and still runs the searches that matter most herself — from the first conversation to the signed offer.

Before FF she led talent for a systematic trading desk in Kuala Lumpur and Singapore, where she learned that the best people are never on the market for long and rarely answer a cold message. That conviction shapes how the studio works: fewer searches, deeper relationships, honest advice.

Daniel Lim is Chief Operating Officer at FF Dev Studio. He runs the engine behind every search: intake, research, interview logistics and offer negotiation, so that a candidate hears back the same day and a client always knows exactly where a search stands.
Daniel came to search from engineering management at a payments company, which is why infrastructure and execution teams tend to land on his desk.

Priya Raghavan is Chief People Officer at FF Dev Studio. She leads candidate relationships across research and AI — the long conversations about where someone should spend the next five years, and what a fund or a lab will actually feel like from the inside.
Priya spent eight years in research recruiting for a multi-strategy fund before joining FF, and has placed heads of research, founding ML hires and entire desk buildouts.
